decoy_engine/declared_casting/_stream.py.reason: typed source staging into private scratch files that the run reads back: two ParquetWriter writes plus two staged adapter writes in the same function; never a published output

decoy_engine/execution/out_of_core/_mult.reason: DuckDB COPY of merged parent keys into private scratch files for the out-of-core join; never published

decoy_engine/execution/out_of_core/_rela.reason: DuckDB COPY of parent keys and winners into private scratch files for the out-of-core join; never published

decoy_engine/execution/out_of_core/_stag.reason: masked-key stage read back by the out-of-core runner; scratch inside the run, never a published output

decoy_engine/vault/_format.py::_encode_r.reason: Parquet segment written to an in-memory buffer that is encrypted into the vault file; never a Parquet file on disk
